summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by WF International Ltd., a Chinese construction company, reporting that it has regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. The filing describes that Nasdaq notified the company on December 24, 2025 of non-compliance, and after a 180-day cure period, the company's closing bid price was above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days (June 8-22, 2026), closing the matter. No special situation transaction is involved—this is a standard exchange compliance update.
